topic: Someone finds their college application essay published as an example
text: Imagine my surprise when I opened my college’s website and saw my application essay featured as an example for prospective students! It’s like my quiet little effort to share my story has grown wings and is now flying out there, inspiring others. I’ve always believed that each of our stories is unique and valuable, and now seeing mine used to help others tell theirs feels incredibly fulfilling. It’s a reminder that sometimes, the words we put out into the world can resonate in unexpected ways. I’m eager to see how future applicants take these examples and craft their own compelling narratives. It’s a wonderful cycle of learning and sharing.
